name: FSMA204ComplianceIntake
description: Credential subject accepted by the FSMA 204 policy's external intake block. Stamped server-side by api/app/service/schema_mapper.py::to_credential_subject from any of the 6 validated FSMA events (Creating, Shipping, Receiving, Transforming, Packing, Unpacking). FR-015: the full original event payload is preserved verbatim under `event`.

eventHash.title: Event hash
eventHash.description: sha256 of the canonical FSMA event, hex-encoded with 0x prefix.

fsma204EventType.title: FSMA 204 event type
fsma204EventType.description: One of the 6 FSMA 204 Critical Tracking Event types.

complianceStatus.title: Compliance status
complianceStatus.description: `compliant` for initial issuance, `superseded` for corrective VCs.

policyVersion.title: Policy version
policyVersion.description: Semantic version of the FSMA 204 Guardian policy.

issuedAt.title: Issued at
issuedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp stamped by the FastAPI mapper at submit time.

supersedes.title: Supersedes (event hash)
supersedes.description: When present, this VC replaces the one identified by the referenced eventHash.

event.title: Original event payload
event.description: Full verbatim FSMA 204 event payload preserved per FR-015.

policyId.title: Policy id
policyId.description: Runtime-injected by Guardian's requestVcDocumentBlock; declared so MGS's auto-injected `additionalProperties: false` doesn't reject the decorated subject.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Runtime-injected by Guardian (parent VC reference; null for root submissions).
